claim_ceiling.statement: Deraux's nice Z[r]^2 lattice Hermitian form and the retained principal-Bolza Hermitian form are explicitly integrally isometric up to scale, but the full Z[r]-linear principal-polarized isometry set has 48 elements and induces the full S3 action on the three nonzero retained W-lines. Thus CM-linearity plus the principal polarization does not select an absolute retained W-line.

exhaustive_integral_ppav_isometry_enumer.proof_of_exhaustiveness: If P^* H_R P=2H_D then A=P*D satisfies A^*H_R A=H_R; conversely every A gives P=A*D.

W_line_ambiguity_under_ppav_CM_isometrie.consequence: Z[r]-linearity, the principal polarization, and the retained CM operator r leave a transitive three-line ambiguity.

product_anchor_consequence.consequence: Without a source-bound choice of the lattice isometry, the unique fixed line of the literal product is transported among all three W-lines.

decision.new_exact_scratch_fact: The Deraux and retained Hermitian forms are explicitly Z[r]-integrally equivalent up to scale, and all 48 such principal-polarized CM identifications are exhausted; their W-line action is full S3.
decision.current_missing_datum: A source-bound lifted KRR/curve-to-lattice marking that chooses one coset of the 48 principal-polarized CM identifications modulo the 16-element stabilizer of a W-line, or equivalently binds a distinguished exact retained element/line.
decision.next_lane_objective: Lift the KRR curve-side action beyond pure A[2] conjugacy and intersect it with the 48-element Z[r]-linear principal-polarized identification set using explicit differential/period/homology or source-derived generator data.
